verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a REST interface for connecting to MCP servers, with OAuth and credentials handled for you, plus scoped service tokens for listing and calling tools. Namespace resources can be managed with scoped API keys, and a CLI covers registry search, adding connections and calling tools. However, server publishing is described as a dashboard flow (enter the URL, complete the publishing flow), no explicit API-UI parity claim exists, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented API for publishing and managing servers, an explicit statement of API/UI parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
